name: Tate Press
description: A dumbbell triceps press that uses a flared-elbow path to emphasize elbow extension.
instructions: Lie back with dumbbells held over your chest and elbows flared slightly.
Lower the bells toward your chest by bending the elbows.
Press back up by extending the elbows.
Repeat without letting the shoulders take over.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: The foundational bilateral barbell row performed in a hip-hinged position to build overall back thickness.
instructions: Stand with a barbell at hip height, grip pronated just outside shoulder-width.
Hip-hinge to roughly 45 degrees with a flat back and braced core.
Row the bar to your lower sternum by driving elbows up and back.
Lower under control to full arm extension before the next rep.

name: Bilateral Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description: A bilateral dumbbell row performed in a hip-hinged position to develop mid-back thickness with equal loading per side.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hip-hinge to about 45 degrees.
Let dumbbells hang directly below shoulders with arms fully extended.
Row both dumbbells to your lower ribs simultaneously.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: A unilateral dumbbell row braced on a bench to allow heavy loading of each side of the mid back independently.
instructions: Place one hand and same-side knee on a flat bench for support.
Grip a dumbbell in the opposite hand and let it hang below the shoulder.
Row the dumbbell to your lower ribs with elbow driving straight up.
Lower to full extension and repeat before switching sides.

name: Wide-Grip Seated Cable Row
description: A seated cable row using a wide pronated grip to emphasize the upper mid-back and rear delts.
instructions: Attach a wide lat bar to the low cable pulley and sit facing the machine.
Grip the bar wide with palms facing down and arms fully extended.
Row the bar to your upper abdomen with elbows flaring outward.
Return to full arm extension under control.

name: Close-Grip Seated Cable Row
description: A seated cable row with a close neutral grip to maximize elbow travel and mid-back engagement.
instructions: Attach a V-bar to the low cable and sit on the bench with feet on the platform.
Grip the V-bar with arms extended and back upright.
Row the V-bar to your lower sternum by pulling elbows straight back.
Return with control to full arm extension.

name: T-Bar Row
description: A barbell row using one end of a barbell in a landmine or floor corner to train the mid-back through a fixed arc.
instructions: Load a barbell in a landmine and straddle the bar in a hip-hinged position.
Grip the bar with both hands using a close neutral grip beneath the plates.
Row the bar to your chest by driving elbows up and back.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: A dumbbell row with the chest supported on an incline bench to remove lower back involvement and isolate the mid-back.
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie prone with chest against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging toward the floor.
Row both dumbbells toward your armpits by driving elbows up.
Lower with full control to the hanging position.

name: Chest-Supported Barbell Row
description: A barbell row performed with the chest supported on a high incline bench for strict mid-back isolation.
instructions: Set an incline bench high and drape your chest over it with a barbell on the floor.
Grip the bar pronated at shoulder width and let it hang at arm's length.
Row the bar to your chest by pulling elbows up and back.
Lower slowly to a dead hang and repeat.

name: Meadows Row
description: A unilateral landmine row with a staggered stance that allows heavy loading and a unique diagonal pull angle.
instructions: Stand perpendicular to a loaded landmine with feet staggered.
Lean over and grip the end of the barbell with the near hand.
Row the bar toward your hip by driving the elbow up and back.
Lower to arm extension and complete reps before switching sides.

name: Pendlay Row
description: A strict barbell row where the bar returns to the floor each rep, demanding explosive mid-back power from a dead stop.
instructions: Set up over a barbell with a pronated grip and a flat, horizontal back.
Brace hard and explosively row the bar to your lower chest.
Return the bar completely to the floor under control.
Regrip and repeat from a dead stop each rep.

name: Yates Row
description: A bentover barbell row with a supinated grip and more upright torso, popularized by Dorian Yates for upper back thickness.
instructions: Grip a barbell with a supinated grip at shoulder width.
Hip-hinge to about 70 degrees (more upright than a standard row).
Row the bar to your lower abdomen with elbows tracking close to your sides.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Kroc Row
description: A high-rep, heavy single-arm dumbbell row performed with controlled momentum for maximum lat and mid-back hypertrophy.
instructions: Brace one arm on a bench and grip a very heavy dumbbell with the other.
Begin rowing with a slight body rotation to allow greater range of motion.
Pull the dumbbell to hip height with the elbow driving past the torso.
Lower and complete all high-rep reps before switching sides.

name: Machine Row with Chest Pad
description: A plate-loaded or selectorized machine row with a chest pad that eliminates spinal loading while targeting the mid-back.
instructions: Adjust the chest pad and seat so your chest rests comfortably on the pad.
Grip the handles with a neutral grip and let arms extend fully.
Row the handles toward your torso by driving elbows back.
Return to full extension with control.

name: Unilateral Machine Row
description: A single-arm version of a plate-loaded machine row to address left-right imbalances in the mid-back.
instructions: Load one side of the machine and press your chest against the pad.
Grip the handle with one hand and let arm fully extend.
Row the handle toward your torso with the elbow driving behind you.
Complete all reps before switching arms.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: A bilateral barbell shrug targeting the upper trapezius through a vertical elevation of the shoulders.
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height with a pronated grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Stand tall with arms fully extended and shoulders relaxed down.
Shrug the shoulders straight up toward the ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: A dumbbell shrug allowing a more natural shoulder path and slightly greater range of motion than a barbell shrug.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms fully extended.
Stand upright with shoulders relaxed and chest tall.
Shrug both shoulders straight up as high as possible.
Lower with control back to the starting position.

name: Cable Shrug
description: A shrug performed using a low cable for constant tension on the upper traps throughout the movement.
instructions: Set a cable to the lowest pulley and attach a straight bar.
Grip the bar and stand upright with arms fully extended down.
Shrug the shoulders straight up toward the ears.
Lower slowly under the constant cable tension.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
description: A shrug using a trap bar for a neutral grip position that allows heavier loading and a more natural shrug path.
instructions: Step inside a trap bar and grip the handles at your sides.
Stand tall with the bar lifted off the floor.
Shrug both shoulders as high as possible toward the ears.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Shrug
description: A shrug with the barbell held behind the body to change the plane of pull and hit the mid-trap fibers differently.
instructions: Hold a barbell behind your back with a pronated grip at arm's length.
Stand upright with a proud chest.
Shrug the shoulders straight upward without rolling them forward.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Cable Shrug
description: A unilateral cable shrug for isolating each upper trap independently with constant tension.
instructions: Set a cable to the lowest position and grip a handle with one hand.
Stand upright with arm fully extended at your side.
Shrug the shoulder on the working side straight upward.
Lower and repeat before switching sides.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: A loaded carry with heavy dumbbells or farmer's handles that builds upper trap endurance and grip strength.
instructions: Pick up heavy dumbbells with one in each hand.
Stand tall with shoulders packed and core braced.
Walk at a controlled pace for the desired distance or time.
Set down with control and rest before the next set.

name: Rack Pull
description: A partial deadlift from a rack with the bar starting above the knees to overload the upper back and traps.
instructions: Set the safety bars in a rack just above knee height and load a barbell.
Grip the bar with a double-overhand or mixed grip.
Drive through the floor and lockout at the top with full hip extension.
Return the bar to the pins under control.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: The foundational hip-hinge compound lift that maximally loads the entire posterior chain from the floor.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot, and grip just outside legs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, lats engaged, and chest tall.
Push the floor away and lock out at the top with full hip extension.
Hinge back down with control, returning the bar to the floor.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: A deadlift variation with a wide stance and narrow grip that shifts loading to the inner thighs and alters the back angle.
instructions: Set feet wide with toes turned out significantly and grip the bar inside the legs.
Squat down with a tall chest and knees tracking over toes.
Drive through the floor while keeping the bar close to the body.
Lock out at the top and lower with control.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip-hinge deadlift variation keeping the knees soft and the bar close to the body to maximally train the lower back and hamstrings.
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height with a pronated grip and slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back while dragging the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep hamstring and lower back stretch.
Drive hips forward to return to standing and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: A unilateral RDL that trains the lower back and hamstrings while challenging hip stability and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge at the hip, reaching the dumbbell toward the floor as the free leg extends behind.
Keep the back flat and lower until a hamstring stretch is felt.
Drive through the standing heel to return upright and repeat.

name: Good Morning
description: A hip-hinge barbell movement with the bar on the upper back that trains the lower back, spinal erectors, and hamstrings.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper traps in a squat rack and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Bend the knees slightly and brace the core.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is near parallel to the floor.
Drive hips forward and raise the torso to the upright position.

name: Back Extension
description: A spinal erector and glute exercise performed on a back extension bench by hinging through the hips.
instructions: Position yourself on a back extension bench with hips at the pad edge and feet anchored.
Cross arms over chest or clasp behind the head.
Lower your torso toward the floor by hinging at the hip.
Raise back to parallel or slightly beyond by contracting the spinal erectors.

name: Weighted Back Extension
description: A back extension performed while holding a weight plate or dumbbell for progressive overload of the spinal erectors.
instructions: Grip a weight plate to your chest and mount a back extension bench.
Lower your torso toward the floor under control.
Contract the spinal erectors and glutes to raise back to parallel.
Hold briefly at the top then lower for the next rep.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: A lower back and glute exercise where the legs are raised while the upper body stays fixed on a bench.
instructions: Lie face-down on a reverse hyper machine with hips at the pad edge.
Grip the handles and let legs hang freely.
Swing legs up by contracting the glutes and lower back.
Lower legs with control and repeat.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
description: A glute-ham developer exercise that eccentrically loads the hamstrings and isometrically loads the lower back.
instructions: Position yourself on a GHD machine with knees on the pad and feet anchored.
Lower your body forward under control using the hamstrings.
Use hamstrings to curl your body back up to the starting position.
Keep the core braced throughout the full range.

name: Barbell Upright Row
description: A barbell pull from the hips to chin-height with elbows leading, targeting the upper traps and side delts.
instructions: Grip a barbell with a close pronated grip, hands 6–8 inches apart.
Stand tall with the bar resting at your hips.
Pull the bar straight up toward your chin, leading with the elbows.
Lower with control back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
description: A dumbbell version of the upright row allowing each arm to move independently for more natural shoulder mechanics.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs with palms facing you.
Stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Pull both dumbbells up toward chin height with elbows leading outward.
Lower under control to the starting position.

name: Face Pull
description: A cable pull to the face using a rope attachment that targets the rear deltoids, upper traps, and external rotators.
instructions: Set a cable to upper-chest height and attach a rope.
Grip the rope with both hands and step back to create tension.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating the ends at your ears.
Pause with elbows back and externally rotated, then return.

name: Band Face Pull
description: A face pull using a resistance band anchored at head height, ideal for home training and shoulder rehab.
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at upper-chest height.
Grip both ends and step back until the band is taut.
Pull both ends toward your face with elbows high and wide.
Pause, then return to full arm extension.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: A bent-over cable fly targeting the rear deltoids and upper mid-back through a horizontal abduction arc.
instructions: Set two cables to shoulder height, grip left with right hand and right with left.
Hinge forward slightly with arms crossed in the center.
Open arms wide in a reverse fly motion, retracting the scapulas.
Return to center with control.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
description: A bent-over dumbbell fly targeting the rear deltoids and upper traps through horizontal abduction.
instructions: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Let dumbbells hang with palms facing each other.
Raise both arms out to the sides with a slight elbow bend.
Squeeze the rear delts at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Reverse Fly
description: A reverse fly performed lying prone on an incline bench to remove torso momentum and isolate the rear delts.
instructions: Lie prone on a 30–45 degree incline bench with dumbbells hanging below the chest.
Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Squeeze the rear delts and mid-traps at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
description: A unilateral cable row with a single handle allowing greater range of motion and rotation for one side at a time.
instructions: Attach a handle to the low cable and sit facing the machine.
Grip the handle with one hand and extend the arm fully.
Row the handle to your lower ribs by pulling the elbow back.
Return to full extension and repeat before switching arms.

name: Single-Arm Chest-Supported Row
description: A unilateral version of the chest-supported row for complete isolation of each side of the mid-back without spinal loading.
instructions: Lie prone on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand hanging below.
Row the dumbbell toward your armpit by driving the elbow up.
Squeeze the mid-back at the top of the movement.
Lower with control and complete reps before switching sides.

name: Renegade Row
description: A plank-position dumbbell row that challenges the core anti-rotation while training the mid-back unilaterally.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands gripping dumbbells on the floor.
Brace the core to prevent rotation and row one dumbbell to your hip.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides each rep while keeping hips square.

name: TRX Row
description: A bodyweight horizontal pull using a suspension trainer, adjustable in difficulty by changing body angle.
instructions: Grip TRX handles with palms facing each other and walk feet forward.
Hang below the anchor with body straight and arms extended.
Pull your chest to the handles by driving elbows behind you.
Lower with control back to the starting position.

name: High Cable Row Elbows Out
description: A standing cable row from a high pulley with elbows flaring wide to target the mid and upper traps.
instructions: Set a cable to chest height and attach a rope.
Stand facing the machine and grip the rope with elbows high.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows flaring wide.
Return with control to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Dead-Row
description: A combination deadlift and bent-over row where each rep starts from a dead stop on the floor.
instructions: Set up over a barbell as you would for a deadlift.
Pull the bar from the floor to hip height as in a deadlift.
Without lowering the bar, row it to your lower sternum.
Lower the bar to the floor and reset before the next rep.

name: Flat Bench Chest-Supported Row
description: A chest-supported dumbbell row performed on a flat bench by lying prone, removing all spinal loading.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench elevated slightly on plates, arms hanging.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Row both dumbbells toward your armpits, retracting the scapulas.
Lower fully and repeat.

name: Split-Stance Standing Cable Row
description: A standing cable row in a split stance that trains the mid-back while challenging core anti-rotation.
instructions: Set a cable to mid-height and stand perpendicular with a split stance.
Grip the handle with the far hand and arm extended toward the cable.
Row the handle to your ribs while resisting rotation.
Return under control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: A resistance band exercise pulling the band apart at chest height to train scapular retraction and mid-traps.
instructions: Hold a resistance band with hands shoulder-width at chest level.
Arms slightly bent, pull the band apart by driving both arms outward.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end range.
Return with control to the starting position.

name: Cable Straight-Arm Row
description: A cable row with straight arms from a standing position, targeting the lat in shoulder extension.
instructions: Set a cable to chest height and grip a straight bar with arms extended forward.
Keeping arms straight, pull the bar toward your hips by contracting the back.
Hold briefly at the hips then slowly return to the forward position.
Repeat for desired reps.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
description: A deadlift performed with a trap bar allowing a more upright torso position and reduced lower back stress.
instructions: Step inside a loaded trap bar and grip the handles at your sides.
Drop the hips and keep the chest tall, lats engaged.
Drive through the floor to stand, locking out at the top.
Lower with control by hinging at the hips and bending knees.

name: Deficit Deadlift
description: A conventional deadlift performed while standing on plates to increase range of motion and lower back demand.
instructions: Stand on a 1–4 inch deficit (plates or platform) with the barbell on the floor.
Set up as a conventional deadlift but with deeper hip and knee flexion.
Drive through the floor, keeping the back flat through the extended range.
Lock out at the top and lower with control.

name: Suitcase Deadlift
description: A unilateral deadlift with the load held at one side to train anti-lateral-flexion strength of the lower back and core.
instructions: Stand beside a dumbbell and reach down with one hand to grip it.
Maintain a vertical spine without leaning toward the weight.
Stand up fully by driving through the floor.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: A cable hip-hinge movement where the rope is pulled between the legs to train the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set a cable to the lowest pulley and attach a rope.
Stand facing away from the machine, straddle the cable, and grip the rope between your legs.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting the cable pull the rope back through.
Drive hips forward to stand, squeezing your glutes at the top.

name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
description: A deadlift with a very wide snatch-grip that increases upper back and trap demand due to the altered bar position.
instructions: Grip the barbell very wide — wider than a clean grip — in a pronated position.
Set up as a conventional deadlift, the wider grip will require a lower hip position.
Pull the bar from the floor maintaining a flat back and engaged upper back.
Lock out at the top with full hip extension.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: A glute-dominant hip thrust that also loads the lumbar erectors isometrically through full hip extension.
instructions: Sit with upper back against a bench, barbell over hips.
Plant feet flat on the floor and drive hips up by contracting the glutes.
Hold at full hip extension with a neutral spine.
Lower hips to near the floor and repeat.

name: Rotational Back Extension
description: A back extension with a rotational component at the top to engage the obliques and erector spinae together.
instructions: Mount a back extension bench and cross hands over chest.
Lower the torso toward the floor.
Raise back up and rotate the torso to one side at the top.
Alternate the rotation direction each rep.

name: Seated Machine Shrug
description: A shrug performed on a selectorized machine in a seated position for stable upper trap isolation.
instructions: Sit at the shrug machine and grip the handles at your sides.
Set the weight and sit upright with shoulders relaxed.
Shrug shoulders straight upward as high as possible.
Lower with control back to the start position.

name: Power Clean
description: An Olympic lift pulling the bar explosively from the floor to the front rack position, heavily loading the traps and upper back.
instructions: Set up over the bar with a hook grip just outside the legs.
Pull from the floor with a strong back, accelerating through the hips.
Explode upward with a triple extension and shrug the traps aggressively.
Catch the bar in a front rack position with elbows high.

name: Barbell High Pull
description: An explosive upright row from the floor that trains the traps, upper back, and pull mechanics of the Olympic clean.
instructions: Grip the barbell at hip width and set up in a deadlift position.
Pull the bar explosively off the floor, extending through the hips.
Continue pulling the bar vertically to chin height with elbows flaring out.
Lower the bar under control and reset.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: A dynamic hip-hinge movement using a kettlebell to train the posterior chain with an emphasis on the glutes and hips.
instructions: Stand behind the kettlebell and hike it back between the legs.
Drive the hips forward forcefully to swing the bell to shoulder height.
Let the bell arc back between the legs in a pendulum motion.
Repeat with a rhythmic hip hinge pattern.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing
description: A unilateral kettlebell swing challenging the lower back and core with anti-rotation demands.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and hike it between the legs.
Drive hips forward to swing the bell to shoulder height.
Resist rotation by bracing the core throughout.
Repeat and switch hands at the desired interval.

name: Sandbag Bent-Over Row
description: A bent-over row using a sandbag for unstable resistance that demands greater grip and back stabilizer activation.
instructions: Stand over a sandbag and grip it at each end in a hip-hinged position.
Row the sandbag to your lower chest, adapting to its shifting weight.
Squeeze the mid-back at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Cable Row
description: A single-arm cable row from a half-kneeling position for hip stability and isolated mid-back training.
instructions: Kneel on one knee facing a mid-height cable with opposite foot forward.
Grip the handle with the arm on the same side as the kneeling knee.
Row the handle to your lower ribs while keeping the torso square.
Return to full extension and complete reps before switching sides.

name: Seal Row
description: A barbell row lying prone on an elevated flat bench, completely eliminating momentum and lower back stress.
instructions: Elevate a flat bench on plates or blocks so the bar can hang at full extension.
Lie face-down and grip the bar just outside shoulder-width.
Row the bar toward the bench by pulling elbows back.
Lower under full control and repeat.

name: Inverted Row Supinated
description: A bodyweight inverted row with a supinated grip to shift emphasis to the lower traps and biceps.
instructions: Lie under a barbell set at hip height and grip it supinated at shoulder width.
Keep your body straight from heels to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the bar by driving elbows behind you.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

name: Seated Good Morning
description: A good morning variation performed seated to increase lower back loading by removing the hip hinge assistance.
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench and rest a barbell on your upper traps.
Sit upright with feet planted on the floor.
Hinge forward from the hips until your chest is near parallel to the floor.
Raise back to the upright position by contracting the lower back.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Row
description: A bentover barbell row with a shoulder-width or narrower grip to emphasize the lower traps and mid-back thickness.
instructions: Grip a barbell with hands directly at shoulder-width using a pronated grip.
Hip-hinge to 45 degrees with a flat back.
Row the bar to your lower abdomen with elbows tracking close to the body.
Lower with control to full arm extension.

name: Dumbbell High Pull
description: An explosive dumbbell pull from below the knee to shoulder height to train the upper traps and pulling mechanics.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at hip height with a slight hip hinge.
Explosively extend hips while pulling dumbbells vertically with elbows leading.
Pull to chin height with elbows flaring outward.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Bilateral Landmine Row
description: A bilateral row using a landmine setup with a V-handle or hands stacked for mid-back loading.
instructions: Straddle the loaded landmine and grip the end with both hands.
Hinge at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Row the end of the bar toward your chest.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Bird-Dog Row
description: A quadruped dumbbell row extending the opposite arm and leg to challenge spinal stability and mid-back activation.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a dumbbell beside one hand.
Extend the opposite leg behind you for balance.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip while maintaining a flat back.
Lower and repeat before switching sides.

name: Prone Y-T-W
description: A bodyweight prone back exercise forming Y, T, and W shapes with the arms to activate the lower traps and rhomboids.
instructions: Lie face-down on the floor or a back extension bench.
Form a Y with arms overhead and hold, squeezing the lower traps.
Bring arms out into a T position and hold, squeezing the mid-traps.
Bend elbows into a W position and hold, squeezing the rhomboids.

name: Seated Cable Row Overhand
description: A seated cable row with a pronated grip targeting the mid-back and posterior shoulder with elbows flaring outward.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low cable and sit with feet on the platform.
Grip the bar with an overhand (pronated) grip at shoulder width.
Row the bar to your upper abdomen with elbows wide.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

name: Bent-Over Trap Raise
description: A dumbbell raise in the prone or bent-over position targeting the lower trapezius fibers.
instructions: Lie prone on an incline bench or flat bench and hold light dumbbells.
Arms angled at 45 degrees from the body in a Y position.
Raise both arms upward by depressing and retracting the scapulas.
Hold briefly at the top then lower with control.

name: Rope Cable Row
description: A seated cable row using a rope to allow natural wrist rotation and a greater elbow range of motion.
instructions: Attach a rope to the low cable and sit on the row bench.
Grip the rope ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the rope to your lower chest, spreading the ends apart at your sides.
Return to full arm extension.

name: One-Arm Barbell Row
description: A unilateral row gripping one end of a barbell to allow heavy loading and natural trunk rotation.
instructions: Hold one end of a barbell with the other end anchored or on the floor.
Hip-hinge and support the free hand on a knee or bench.
Row the barbell end toward your hip by driving the elbow back.
Lower and repeat before switching sides.

name: Overhead Barbell Shrug
description: A shrug with the barbell pressed overhead targeting the upper and lower traps in a demanding overhead position.
instructions: Clean and press or snatch a barbell to the overhead position.
Hold the bar locked out overhead with arms straight.
Shrug the shoulders upward toward the ears without bending the elbows.
Lower the shrug with control and repeat.

name: Standing Low Cable Row
description: A standing version of the seated cable row with added core stability demand.
instructions: Attach a V-bar to the low cable and stand facing the machine.
Grip the V-bar with arms extended and slight knee bend.
Row the bar to your lower abdomen while keeping the torso stable.
Return to full extension and repeat.

name: Trap Bar Row
description: A bent-over row using a trap bar for a neutral-grip bilateral mid-back row with natural hand position.
instructions: Step inside a trap bar and hip-hinge to parallel.
Grip the handles with a neutral grip and arms fully extended.
Row the bar toward your hips by driving elbows straight back.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
description: A bent-over row performed on a Smith machine for a fixed vertical bar path and strict back loading.
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at mid-thigh height and grip it pronated.
Stand with hips hinged to about 45 degrees and back flat.
Row the bar to your lower sternum by pulling elbows straight back.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Resistance Band Bent-Over Row
description: A bent-over row using a resistance band anchored underfoot for mid-back training without equipment.
instructions: Stand on a resistance band with both feet and grip the ends with each hand.
Hip-hinge to 45 degrees with a flat back.
Row both ends toward your lower chest with elbows driving back.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Cable Chest-Supported Row
description: A chest-supported row using a cable machine to provide constant tension through the full range of motion.
instructions: Position an incline bench in front of a low cable and lie prone against it.
Grip the V-bar and let arms extend toward the cable.
Row the attachment toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Return to full extension.

name: Low Cable Pull-Apart
description: A cable pull-apart from a low pulley for targeted upper mid-back and rear delt activation.
instructions: Attach two handles to two low cables and grip them crossed in front.
Stand with slight forward lean and arms crossed at chest height.
Pull arms apart in a horizontal reverse-fly motion.
Return to the crossed starting position with control.

name: Neutral-Grip Machine Row
description: A machine row with a neutral grip attachment for a mid-back stimulus without wrist or elbow strain.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, select weight on the machine.
Grip the neutral handles and let arms fully extend.
Pull handles toward your torso with elbows tracking behind you.
Return to full extension with control.

name: Prone Incline Dumbbell Shrug
description: A shrug performed in a bent-over or prone position to isolate the mid and lower trapezius fibers.
instructions: Lie prone on an incline bench and hold light dumbbells at arm's length.
Without bending the elbows, retract and depress the shoulder blades.
Lift the dumbbells by squeezing the mid traps.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Deficit Barbell Row
description: A bent-over barbell row performed standing on plates to increase the range of motion and stretch at the bottom.
instructions: Stand on weight plates to create a 2–4 inch deficit.
Grip a barbell and hip-hinge to parallel.
Row the bar from below the standard starting height to your lower chest.
Lower with control through the full extended range.

name: Superman Hold
description: A bodyweight prone isometric hold lifting arms and legs off the floor simultaneously to activate the spinal erectors.
instructions: Lie face-down on the floor with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Hold with full spinal extension and glutes contracted.
Lower and rest before the next rep.

name: Banded Good Morning
description: A good morning using a resistance band anchored underfoot for hip-hinge lower back training without a barbell.
instructions: Step on a resistance band with both feet and loop it behind the neck.
Stand upright with the band creating tension.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is near parallel.
Drive hips forward to return to the upright position.

name: Seated Band Row
description: A seated row using a looped resistance band around the feet for mid-back training at home or as a warm-up.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Grip both ends of the band with arms fully extended.
Row both ends toward your lower ribs by pulling elbows back.
Return to full extension and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Smith Machine Row
description: A unilateral row on a Smith machine providing a fixed path for strict mid-back isolation one side at a time.
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at mid-thigh and grip it with one hand.
Stand beside the bar and brace with the free hand on your knee.
Row the bar toward your hip by pulling the elbow straight back.
Lower and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Bear Row
description: An alternating single-arm dumbbell row from the bear-plank position that trains the mid-back under heavy core stability demand.
instructions: Start in a bear-plank position with knees hovering just off the floor and a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace the core and keep the hips level.
Row the dumbbell to your ribs without letting the torso rotate.
Lower it under control and alternate sides each rep.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Shrug
description: A unilateral dumbbell shrug isolating one upper trap at a time for symmetry correction.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side with arm extended.
Stand tall and relax the shoulder on the working side.
Shrug only the working shoulder straight upward.
Lower with control and complete reps before switching sides.

name: GHD Back Extension Isometric
description: An isometric hold at full extension on a glute-ham developer targeting the spinal erectors and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a GHD machine with hips at the pad edge.
Lower the torso to horizontal or slightly beyond.
Hold the position isometrically by contracting the glutes and spinal erectors.
Release after the desired hold time.

name: Bilateral Kettlebell Row
description: A bilateral bent-over row using kettlebells for a neutral grip mid-back stimulus.
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor and stand between them in a hip-hinge.
Grip each kettlebell handle and let arms hang.
Row both bells to your lower ribs simultaneously.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Row
description: A unilateral kettlebell row allowing natural forearm rotation through the range of motion.
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench and hold a kettlebell in the other.
Allow the kettlebell to hang below the shoulder.
Row the kettlebell to your hip by driving the elbow back.
Lower and repeat before switching sides.

name: Supine Barbell Row
description: A bodyweight row hanging below a barbell set in a low rack, similar to an inverted row.
instructions: Lie under a barbell set low in a rack and grip it pronated at shoulder-width.
Keep the body rigid from heel to shoulder.
Pull the chest up to the bar with elbows driving behind you.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

name: Braced Hip Barbell Row
description: A bent-over barbell row with the hips braced against a rack bar or pad to reduce lower back stress.
instructions: Rest your hips against a rack safety bar at the appropriate height.
Hold a barbell and let it hang at arm's length below the chest.
Row the bar toward your lower chest with elbows driving back.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Machine Upright Row
description: An upright row performed on a cable or plate-loaded machine for a guided path and consistent trap loading.
instructions: Attach a short bar to the low cable pulley.
Grip the bar with a close pronated grip and stand upright.
Pull the bar up to chin height, leading with elbows.
Lower slowly back to the starting position.

name: High-to-Low Cable Row
description: A cable row from a high anchor pulled downward and back to emphasize the lower traps and lower fibers of the back.
instructions: Set a cable to the highest position and grip a single handle.
Stand facing the machine and extend the arm toward the high cable.
Pull the handle diagonally down and back toward your hip.
Return along the same diagonal path and repeat.

name: Lateral Back Extension
description: A back extension variation where the body tilts laterally to target the quadratus lumborum and lateral spinal erectors.
instructions: Mount a back extension bench but position your body sideways.
Anchor the lower hip on the pad and let the upper body hang laterally.
Raise your torso upward by contracting the lateral back muscles.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Tire Flip
description: A full-body explosive movement flipping a heavy tire that maximally loads the lower back, traps, and legs.
instructions: Squat beside the tire and grip its bottom edge with both hands.
Drive through the legs explosively and pull the tire up onto your thighs.
Re-grip and push the tire forward onto the next face.
Walk forward and repeat.

name: Wide-Grip Seated Row Machine
description: A selectorized seated row with a wide grip targeting the posterior delts and upper mid-back.
instructions: Select the wide-grip attachment on a seated row machine.
Adjust the chest pad and sit with a tall spine.
Row the handles toward your upper chest with elbows flaring wide.
Return to full arm extension.

name: Incline Single-Arm Cable Row
description: A prone incline single-arm cable row combining chest support with cable constant tension for one-sided mid-back isolation.
instructions: Position an incline bench in front of a low cable and lie prone.
Grip a single handle with one hand and let it extend toward the pulley.
Row the handle toward your armpit by pulling the elbow back.
Lower to full extension and repeat before switching sides.

name: Kneeling Cable Row
description: A bilateral cable row from a kneeling position for core stability and mid-back development without leg drive.
instructions: Kneel on both knees facing a low cable pulley.
Grip a V-bar with both hands and sit back on your heels for stability.
Row the bar toward your lower abdomen by driving elbows back.
Return to full extension and repeat.

name: Barbell Row with Hip Drive
description: A barbell row using controlled hip drive to overload the mid-back with supramaximal weights.
instructions: Use a weight heavier than a strict row allows and grip the bar pronated.
Hinge and initiate with a slight hip extension to create momentum.
Row the bar to the lower sternum using the back to control the movement.
Lower with full control and reset.

name: Single-Arm Cable Face Pull
description: A unilateral face pull that allows greater rotation and shoulder external rotation focus on each side.
instructions: Set a cable at upper-chest height and grip a handle with one hand.
Step back and pull the handle to your ear with elbow high and flared.
Externally rotate the shoulder at peak contraction.
Return and repeat before switching sides.

name: Single-Arm Wide-Elbow Seated Row
description: A single-arm seated cable row with a high elbow flare to target the rear delt and upper back unilaterally.
instructions: Sit at a cable station and grip a single handle with one hand.
Row the handle toward your upper chest with the elbow flared high and wide.
Squeeze the rear delt and upper trap at the peak.
Return to full extension and repeat before switching.

name: Weighted Ring Row
description: A gymnastics ring row performed with added weight via a vest or belt for progressive mid-back overload.
instructions: Put on a weighted vest and set rings to waist height.
Grip rings and hang below them with body rigid.
Row your chest to ring height by driving elbows back.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Snatch-Grip Rack Pull
description: A rack pull performed with a snatch grip to maximally load the upper traps and rhomboids through the lockout.
instructions: Set a barbell above the knee in a rack and grip wide in a snatch position.
Stand with the bar at thigh height as a starting position.
Drive to full extension and squeeze the upper traps at lockout.
Lower with control to the pins.

name: Monkey Row
description: A standing dumbbell pull dragging the elbows up along the sides, blending a shrug and upright row to hit the traps with less shoulder stress.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at each side.
Drag both elbows straight up along your sides, letting the wrists trail.
Stop when the elbows reach roughly armpit height and squeeze the traps.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Rotational Cable Row
description: A seated single-arm cable row incorporating trunk rotation to train the mid-back and thoracic rotators together.
instructions: Sit sideways on a cable row bench and grip a single handle.
Rotate the torso toward the cable to create a pre-stretch.
Row the handle and rotate the torso away simultaneously.
Return to the start by reversing the rotation.

name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
description: A standing machine calf raise that trains the calves through a full range of ankle motion.
instructions: Set the pads and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels under control.
Drive through your toes to rise as high as you can.
Pause briefly, then repeat smoothly.

name: Single-Leg Standing Calf Raise Machine
description: A unilateral standing machine calf raise for focused calf development and balance.
instructions: Set the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Lower the working heel slowly.
Press through the big toe to lift high.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

name: Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise
description: A Smith machine calf raise that provides stable vertical loading for the calves.
instructions: Place the bar across your upper back and stand on a block.
Let your heels drop with control.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly and repeat for smooth reps.

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
description: A standing barbell calf raise that loads the calves with free-weight resistance.
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Lower your heels under control.
Press through your forefoot to lift high.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
description: A standing calf raise using dumbbells for simple and scalable calf loading.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Lower your heels until you feel a stretch.
Push through your toes to rise up fully.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
description: A unilateral dumbbell calf raise that increases the challenge on each calf separately.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell and balance on the working leg.
Lower the heel slowly off a step or floor.
Press up onto the ball of the foot.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
description: A basic bodyweight calf raise that builds calf strength with minimal setup.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Lower your heels if using a step, or stay flat on the floor.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
description: A bodyweight single-leg calf raise that improves calf strength and control one side at a time.
instructions: Balance on one foot near a wall or rail.
Lower the working heel under control.
Drive up onto your toes without twisting.
Repeat, then switch legs.

name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
description: A seated calf raise that emphasizes the calves with the knees bent.
instructions: Sit with the pad across your thighs and feet on the platform.
Lower your heels until you feel a stretch.
Push through your toes to lift the weight.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Seated Calf Raise Machine
description: A unilateral seated calf raise for direct calf work with bent-knee positioning.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Lower the heel slowly.
Drive through the forefoot to raise the pad.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise using a barbell across the thighs for heavy direct calf loading.
instructions: Sit on a bench with the barbell across your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a block.
Lower your heels under control.
Raise up hard through your toes and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise with dumbbells that is easy to set up and progress.
instructions: Sit on a bench and place the dumbbells on your thighs.
Set the balls of your feet on a small block.
Lower your heels slowly.
Press up through your toes and repeat.

name: Plate Seated Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise using weight plates across the thighs for straightforward soleus work.
instructions: Sit tall and place plates across your thighs.
Set your forefeet on a block or step.
Lower the heels under control.
Lift high through the ankles and repeat.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
description: A calf raise performed on the leg press sled for stable and heavy calf loading.
instructions: Place the balls of your feet low on the sled.
Unlock the sled with knees only slightly bent.
Lower your heels under control.
Press through your toes to move the sled and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press Calf Raise
description: A unilateral leg press calf raise that challenges each calf independently under load.
instructions: Place one foot low on the sled and brace your torso.
Keep the knee soft but still.
Lower the heel slowly.
Drive through the forefoot, then switch sides.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
description: A bent-over calf raise that places the calves under a deep loaded stretch.
instructions: Hinge forward and place the balls of your feet on a platform.
Let the heels drop under control.
Press through the toes to raise the heels high.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Donkey Calf Raise
description: A bodyweight donkey calf raise that trains the calves in a bent-over position.
instructions: Hinge forward and hold onto a stable support.
Place the balls of your feet on a step.
Lower the heels slowly.
Rise up hard through your toes and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Donkey Calf Raise
description: A Smith machine donkey calf raise that adds stable external load to the bent-over calf pattern.
instructions: Position yourself under the Smith bar in a bent-over stance.
Place the balls of your feet on a block.
Lower your heels with control.
Press up strongly through the calves and repeat.

name: Barbell Donkey Calf Raise
description: A donkey calf raise using a barbell for free-weight loading in a stretched calf position.
instructions: Set a bar securely across your hips or lower back in the donkey setup.
Place the balls of your feet on a block.
Lower the heels under control.
Drive up through the ankles and repeat.

name: Hack Squat Calf Raise
description: A calf raise on the hack squat machine that provides a stable path and high loading potential.
instructions: Stand on the platform with your shoulders under the pads.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Lower your heels under control.
Press through your toes to lift and repeat.

name: Trap Bar Calf Raise
description: A loaded standing calf raise using a trap bar for balanced free-weight resistance.
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar with feet stable.
Raise the heels slightly off the floor or use a block.
Lower under control.
Drive up onto your toes and repeat.

name: Belt Squat Calf Raise
description: A belt squat calf raise that loads the calves without spinal compression.
instructions: Attach the belt and stand on the platform.
Lower the heels as far as comfortable.
Push through the forefoot to rise high.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Cable Standing Calf Raise
description: A standing cable calf raise that provides constant tension through the ankles.
instructions: Hold the cable attachment and stand tall.
Lower your heels with control.
Press through your toes against the cable tension.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Cable Calf Raise
description: A unilateral cable calf raise that keeps tension on the working calf throughout the rep.
instructions: Attach the cable for balance or loading and stand on one foot.
Lower the working heel slowly.
Drive up onto the ball of the foot.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: Resistance Band Standing Calf Raise
description: A standing calf raise using band resistance for simple portable calf training.
instructions: Loop the band for downward resistance and stand tall.
Lower your heels under control.
Push through your toes to rise high.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Resistance Band Seated Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise with a resistance band that targets the calves with bent knees.
instructions: Sit with your legs bent and the band anchored over your forefeet.
Let the ankles bend back slightly.
Press the toes away against the band.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Toe Walk
description: A bodyweight toe walk that builds calf endurance and lower-leg stiffness.
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted the whole time.
Walk forward with short controlled steps.
Stay tall and continue for distance or time.

name: Weighted Toe Walk
description: A loaded toe walk that challenges the calves through continuous time under tension.
instructions: Hold the load and rise onto your toes.
Keep the heels high as you start walking.
Take short controlled steps.
Maintain posture and continue for the set.

name: Single-Leg Donkey Calf Raise
description: A unilateral donkey calf raise that loads one calf heavily in a stretched bent-over position.
instructions: Hinge forward and hold a stable support with one foot on a step.
Lift the nonworking foot and let the working heel drop under control.
Press up hard through the ball of the working foot.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
description: A unilateral seated calf raise using a dumbbell for direct bent-knee calf loading on one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench with the ball of one foot on a block and a dumbbell on the working thigh.
Lower the heel slowly into a stretch.
Drive through the forefoot to raise the heel high.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise using a kettlebell on the thighs for simple direct soleus training.
instructions: Sit on a bench with the kettlebell resting securely across your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a small block or step.
Lower your heels under control.
Press up through your toes and repeat.

name: Stair Calf Raise
description: A calf raise done on a stair or step to increase range of motion for the calves.
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Hold support if needed and lower your heels.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Stair Calf Raise
description: A single-leg step calf raise that adds range of motion and unilateral demand.
instructions: Stand on one foot with the forefoot on a step.
Lower the heel below the step level.
Press up high through the working calf.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: Dip Belt Calf Raise
description: A calf raise using a dip belt for heavy loading with minimal upper-body involvement.
instructions: Attach the dip belt and stand on sturdy blocks.
Balance on the balls of your feet.
Lower the heels under control.
Drive up through your toes and repeat.

name: Adductor Machine
description: A seated machine exercise that isolates the inner thighs through controlled hip adduction.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs against the pads.
Brace your torso and keep your hips still.
Squeeze the pads inward under control.
Return slowly to the start and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Adductor Machine
description: A unilateral adductor machine variation that trains one inner thigh at a time.
instructions: Sit in the machine and set one leg against the working pad.
Keep your torso stable.
Pull the pad inward with the working leg.
Return slowly, then switch sides.

name: Standing Cable Hip Adduction
description: A cable hip adduction that directly trains the inner thigh with constant tension.
instructions: Attach the cuff to one ankle and stand tall.
Brace your torso and keep the working leg long.
Sweep the leg inward across your body.
Return with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Standing Resistance Band Hip Adduction
description: A standing band adduction that targets the inner thighs with portable resistance.
instructions: Anchor the band to one side and attach it to your ankle.
Stand tall and brace your torso.
Pull the leg inward against the band.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

name: Standing Ankle Weight Hip Adduction
description: A standing inner-thigh raise using ankle weights for simple direct adductor work.
instructions: Attach the ankle weight and hold a support.
Keep the torso upright and the leg straight.
Lift the leg inward across the midline.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Standing Multi-Hip Machine Adduction
description: A standing machine adduction that isolates the inner thigh through a guided path.
instructions: Set the pad against the inside of the working leg.
Stand tall and brace your trunk.
Drive the leg inward through the machine arc.
Return smoothly and switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
description: A side-lying adduction exercise that isolates the inner thigh without external loading.
instructions: Lie on your side with the top leg out of the way.
Keep the bottom leg straight.
Lift the bottom leg upward toward the midline.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
description: A wide-stance barbell deadlift that heavily recruits the inner thighs along with the hips and trunk.
instructions: Take a wide stance with the bar over midfoot and grip inside your legs.
Brace hard and keep your chest lifted as you pull.
Drive through the floor until your hips and knees lock out.
Lower the bar under control and repeat.

name: Copenhagen Plank
description: An adductor-focused plank where the top leg supports the body on a bench.
instructions: Place your top leg on a bench and set up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight side-plank line.
Hold steady while driving the top leg into the bench.
Lower with control after the hold or reps.

name: Copenhagen Knee Plank
description: A shortened Copenhagen plank variation that trains the adductors with reduced leverage.
instructions: Place your top knee on a bench and set your forearm under the shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Hold the position while pressing into the bench.
Lower slowly and switch sides.

name: Copenhagen Hip Dip
description: A dynamic Copenhagen variation that adds hip movement to the adductor plank pattern.
instructions: Set up in a Copenhagen plank with your top leg supported.
Lift your hips into line.
Lower the hips slightly, then raise them back up.
Repeat smoothly before switching sides.

name: Adductor Slide
description: A sliding adduction exercise that loads the inner thighs through controlled leg movement.
instructions: Stand with one foot on a slider and the other planted.
Brace and keep the planted leg stable.
Slide the working leg inward using the inner thigh.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

name: Sliding Side Lunge
description: A lateral lunge using a slider that emphasizes controlled inner-thigh loading.
instructions: Stand tall with one foot on a slider.
Slide that foot out to the side as you sit back.
Drive through the planted foot to return.
Repeat on one side, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
description: A dumbbell sumo deadlift that trains the inner thighs through a wide-stance deadlift pattern.
instructions: Hold the dumbbell or dumbbells between your legs with a wide stance.
Hinge down while keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your feet.
Drive through the floor to stand tall.
Lower back down under control and repeat.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: A classic side lunge that loads the inner thighs during the lateral descent and return.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step out to the side and sit back into the working hip.
Keep the opposite leg long as you lower.
Drive back to the start and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
description: A lateral lunge loaded with dumbbells for added resistance through the inner thighs and legs.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells and stand tall.
Step out to the side and lower under control.
Push through the planted foot to return.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
description: A barbell lateral lunge that adds free-weight loading to the side lunge pattern.
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and stand tall.
Step laterally and sit back into the working hip.
Keep your chest up as you lower.
Drive back to the start and repeat.

name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
description: A landmine lateral lunge that provides a stable front-loaded path for inner-thigh training.
instructions: Hold the landmine at chest height.
Step laterally and lower into the working leg.
Keep the load close as you push back to center.
Repeat and then switch sides.

name: Cossack Squat
description: A deep side-to-side squat that challenges adductor mobility and strength.
instructions: Take a wide stance and shift your weight to one side.
Sit deep into one hip while the other leg stays long.
Keep your chest up and heel planted.
Drive back up and alternate sides.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
description: A kettlebell sumo deadlift that loads the inner thighs and hips from a wide pulling stance.
instructions: Set the kettlebell between your feet and take a wide stance.
Sit your hips down and grip the handle with a long spine.
Stand up by driving through your feet and extending your hips.
Lower the kettlebell back to the floor under control.

name: Goblet Cossack Squat
description: A goblet-loaded Cossack squat that adds front-loaded resistance to the adductor-focused squat pattern.
instructions: Hold the weight at your chest and take a wide stance.
Shift into one hip and squat down.
Keep the opposite leg straight and toes up if needed.
Drive back up and alternate sides.

name: Suspension Cossack Squat
description: A suspension-assisted Cossack squat that helps control depth in the lateral squat pattern.
instructions: Hold the straps and take a wide stance.
Lower into one side while keeping the other leg long.
Use the straps lightly to guide the movement.
Push back up and alternate sides.

name: Landmine Cossack Squat
description: A landmine-loaded Cossack squat that adds stable resistance to a deep lateral squat.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine in front of your chest.
Shift into one side and descend with control.
Keep the load close as you reach depth.
Drive back up and alternate sides.

name: Sumo Squat
description: A wide-stance squat that places extra demand on the inner thighs during the squat pattern.
instructions: Take a wide stance and brace your torso.
Sit straight down while keeping your knees tracking out.
Lower until comfortable depth.
Stand back up and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
description: A dumbbell-loaded sumo squat that strengthens the inner thighs with simple loading.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
Take a wide stance and brace.
Squat down under control.
Drive through your feet to stand tall and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
description: A kettlebell sumo squat that loads the inner thighs and legs from a wide stance.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns and take a wide stance.
Sit down between your hips under control.
Keep your chest lifted at the bottom.
Stand back up and repeat.

name: Barbell Sumo Squat
description: A barbell sumo squat that adds heavier loading to the inner-thigh-focused squat pattern.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and take a wide stance.
Brace and squat down with control.
Keep your knees tracking over your feet.
Drive up to standing and repeat.

name: Landmine Sumo Squat
description: A landmine sumo squat that offers a stable front-loaded option for wide-stance squatting.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine at chest height.
Set your feet wide and brace.
Squat down between your hips.
Stand back up smoothly and repeat.

name: Landmine Sumo Deadlift
description: A landmine sumo deadlift that provides a stable arc while training the inner thighs in a wide-stance pull.
instructions: Straddle the end of the bar and take a wide stance.
Hinge down to grasp the sleeve while keeping your chest tall.
Drive through your feet to stand and bring the bar up smoothly.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Seated Adductor Ball Squeeze
description: A seated inner-thigh squeeze that isolates the adductors with minimal setup.
instructions: Sit upright with a ball between your knees.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze inward through the thighs.
Release under control and repeat.

name: Supine Adductor Ball Squeeze
description: A supine adductor squeeze that trains the inner thighs while keeping the body supported.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between them.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Squeeze the ball with your thighs.
Release slowly and repeat.

name: Glute Bridge with Ball Squeeze
description: A bridge with an adductor squeeze that trains the inner thighs and hips together.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between them.
Squeeze the ball and lift your hips.
Hold the top position briefly without losing tension.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Standing Adductor Ball Squeeze
description: A standing adductor squeeze that targets the inner thighs in an upright posture.
instructions: Stand tall with a ball between your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and torso still.
Squeeze inward through the inner thighs.
Release slightly and repeat.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
description: A seated machine exercise that isolates the outer thighs through hip abduction.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs against the pads.
Brace your torso and keep your feet planted.
Press the pads outward under control.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Hip Abductor Machine
description: A unilateral hip abduction machine variation that trains one outer thigh at a time.
instructions: Sit in the machine and position one leg on the working pad.
Keep your hips square to the seat.
Press the leg outward against the pad.
Return slowly, then switch sides.

name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction
description: A standing cable abduction that directly targets the outer thighs with constant tension.
instructions: Attach the cuff to one ankle and stand tall.
Brace your torso and keep the leg mostly straight.
Sweep the leg out to the side.
Return slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Standing Resistance Band Hip Abduction
description: A standing band abduction that trains the outer thighs with simple portable resistance.
instructions: Anchor the band and attach it to your ankle.
Stand tall and brace your trunk.
Lift the leg out to the side against the band.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

name: Standing Ankle Weight Hip Abduction
description: A standing outer-thigh raise using ankle weights for direct hip abductor work.
instructions: Attach the ankle weight and hold a support.
Keep the torso upright and the leg long.
Lift the leg out to the side.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Standing Multi-Hip Machine Abduction
description: A standing machine abduction that trains the outer thighs through a guided arc.
instructions: Set the pad against the outside of the working leg.
Stand tall and brace your trunk.
Drive the leg outward through the machine arc.
Return smoothly and switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
description: A side-lying exercise that isolates the outer thigh and hip abductors without heavy setup.
instructions: Lie on your side with the bottom leg bent if needed.
Keep the top leg straight and hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling back.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Side-Lying Banded Hip Abduction
description: A side-lying hip abduction with a mini band for added tension on the outer thighs.
instructions: Loop the band above your knees or ankles and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and brace lightly.
Lift the top leg against the band.
Lower under control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Side Plank Hip Abduction
description: A side plank with top-leg raises that trains the outer thigh while challenging stability.
instructions: Set up in a solid side plank.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Raise the top leg without twisting your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat on both sides.

name: Clamshell
description: A bent-knee hip abduction exercise that isolates the outer thighs and glute-side muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your pelvis stacked and heels touching.
Open the top knee without rolling backward.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Banded Clamshell
description: A clamshell with a mini band that adds resistance to the outer-thigh opening pattern.
instructions: Loop a band above your knees and lie on your side.
Keep your feet together and core lightly braced.
Open the top knee against the band.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Side Plank Clamshell
description: A clamshell performed from a side plank to combine hip abduction with trunk stability.
instructions: Set up in a bent-knee side plank.
Keep your knees bent and feet together.
Open the top knee while holding the plank.
Close slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Fire Hydrant
description: A quadruped hip abduction exercise that targets the outer thighs and side glutes.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep one knee bent at ninety degrees.
Lift that knee out to the side without twisting.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Banded Fire Hydrant
description: A fire hydrant with a band that increases tension on the outer thighs through the lift.
instructions: Loop a band above your knees and get on all fours.
Keep the working knee bent.
Lift the knee out to the side against the band.
Lower with control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Cable Fire Hydrant
description: A cable-loaded fire hydrant that keeps tension on the hip abductors throughout the rep.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to the low cable and get into position.
Keep the knee bent and torso steady.
Lift the leg out to the side against the cable.
Return slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Quadruped Straight-Leg Hip Abduction
description: A straight-leg quadruped abduction that trains the outer thigh with longer lever resistance.
instructions: Start on hands and knees and extend one leg straight.
Brace your trunk and square your hips.
Lift the straight leg out to the side.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Lateral Band Walk
description: A resisted side-stepping drill that strengthens the outer thighs during repeated abduction.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or above your knees.
Sit into a shallow athletic stance.
Step sideways without letting the band snap back.
Continue for the planned distance, then reverse.

name: X-Band Walk
description: A standing band walk using crossed bands to create constant outer-thigh tension.
instructions: Stand on the band and cross the ends into an X.
Sink slightly into your hips.
Step sideways with steady tension on the band.
Continue for distance, then reverse direction.

name: Monster Walk
description: A forward-and-back band walk that challenges the outer thighs in an athletic stance.
instructions: Loop the band above your knees or at your ankles.
Take a shallow squat stance.
Step diagonally forward with control, then continue alternating.
Reverse the pattern to return.

name: Seated Band Hip Abduction
description: A seated band abduction that isolates the outer thighs with constant outward pressure.
instructions: Sit upright with a band above your knees.
Keep your feet planted and core braced.
Press your knees outward against the band.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Banded Squat Abduction
description: A squat with a band that keeps the outer thighs active through the full lower-body movement.
instructions: Loop the band above your knees and stand tall.
Squat down while keeping pressure out against the band.
Stand up without letting the knees cave in.
Repeat for smooth controlled reps.

name: Curtsy Lunge
description: A cross-behind lunge that places extra demand on the outer thigh of the front leg.
instructions: Stand tall and step one leg behind and across.
Lower into the front leg under control.
Push through the front foot to return.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
description: A loaded curtsy lunge that strengthens the outer thighs with additional resistance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Step one leg behind and across.
Lower with control and keep your chest up.
Drive through the front foot to return and repeat.

name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge
description: A barbell curtsy lunge that adds heavier loading to the cross-behind lunge pattern.
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back.
Step one leg behind and across the body.
Lower under control into the front hip.
Drive back up and repeat before switching sides.

name: Lateral Step-Up
description: A step-up performed from the side that trains the outer thigh of the working leg.
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place the inside foot on the box and brace.
Drive through that foot to stand up.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Step-Up
description: A loaded lateral step-up that challenges the outer thighs with added resistance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells and stand beside a box.
Place the inside foot firmly on the platform.
Drive up through the working leg.
Lower under control and repeat before switching sides.

name: Crossover Step-Up
description: A cross-body step-up that increases outer-thigh demand through frontal-plane control.
instructions: Stand slightly to the side of the box.
Cross one foot onto the box and brace.
Drive through that foot to step up.
Lower carefully and repeat before switching sides.

name: Lateral Box Step-Over
description: A lateral box step-over that trains the outer thighs through repeated side-to-side stepping.
instructions: Stand beside the box and step onto it from the side.
Keep your torso tall as you move across.
Step down the far side under control.
Continue side to side for the set.

name: Lateral Sled Drag
description: A lateral sled drag that loads the outer thighs while resisting side-to-side movement.
instructions: Attach the sled and stand sideways to the direction of travel.
Sink into a light athletic stance.
Step laterally with steady tension on the sled.
Continue for distance, then switch directions.

name: Glute Bridge with Band Abduction
description: A glute bridge with a band around the knees that adds continuous outer-thigh abduction tension.
instructions: Loop a band above your knees and lie on your back with knees bent.
Press your knees outward to create band tension.
Lift your hips into a bridge while keeping the band spread apart.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Hip Thrust with Band Abduction
description: A hip thrust with a band around the knees that trains the outer thighs to resist knee collapse at lockout.
instructions: Set your upper back on a bench with a band above your knees.
Plant your feet and keep outward pressure against the band.
Drive your hips up to full lockout without letting the knees cave in.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Lateral Bound
description: An explosive side-to-side jump that develops the outer thighs through powerful lateral push-offs.
instructions: Start in an athletic stance on one leg.
Push laterally and jump to the other side.
Land softly and stabilize the hip.
Repeat side to side with control.

name: Lateral Step-Down
description: A controlled step-down from the side that challenges outer-thigh strength and stability.
instructions: Stand sideways on a box with one foot planted.
Lower the free heel toward the floor under control.
Drive through the standing leg to return tall.
Repeat before switching sides.

name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
description: A foundational compound press performed flat on a bench using a barbell to build overall chest mass and strength.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with eyes under the bar, grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it under control to mid-chest.
Press the bar back up explosively until arms are fully extended.
Re-rack safely after completing all reps.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: A compound chest press on an inclined bench targeting the upper chest and anterior deltoids.
instructions: Set bench to 30–45 degrees and lie back with the bar at upper chest height.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack.
Lower the bar to the upper chest in a controlled manner.
Press explosively back to the start position.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
description: A compound press on a declined bench that shifts emphasis to the lower chest.
instructions: Secure feet on a decline bench and lie back with the bar over lower chest.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack.
Lower the bar to the lower chest in a controlled arc.
Press back up to full arm extension and repeat.

name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A compound chest press using dumbbells that allows a greater range of motion and independent arm movement.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells on thighs, then kick back to lying position.
Hold dumbbells at chest level with palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells up until arms are extended, keeping wrists neutral.
Lower dumbbells under control to chest level and repeat.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A compound incline press with dumbbells targeting the upper chest with independent arm movement.
instructions: Set bench to 30–45 degrees, sit and kick dumbbells to chest level.
Hold dumbbells at shoulder width, palms forward.
Press both dumbbells up to full extension.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A compound press on a decline bench using dumbbells to emphasize the lower chest.
instructions: Secure feet on a decline bench and hold dumbbells at lower chest level.
Keep palms facing forward, elbows flared slightly.
Press the dumbbells up until arms are extended.
Lower slowly back to the start and repeat.

name: Flat Dumbbell Fly
description: An isolation fly movement performed flat that stretches and contracts the mid chest through a wide arc.
instructions: Lie flat holding dumbbells above chest with a slight elbow bend.
Lower dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until a stretch is felt.
Squeeze the chest to bring the dumbbells back together at the top.
Repeat with controlled movement throughout.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: An isolation fly on an inclined bench that maximally stretches and contracts the upper chest.
instructions: Set bench to 30–45 degrees and hold dumbbells above upper chest.
Maintain a slight elbow bend and lower dumbbells in a wide arc.
Feel a deep stretch in the upper chest at the bottom.
Bring dumbbells back together at the top, squeezing the chest.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
description: An isolation fly on a decline bench to target the lower chest through a full range of motion.
instructions: Secure feet on a decline bench, hold dumbbells above lower chest.
With a slight elbow bend, lower dumbbells in a wide arc.
Stretch the lower chest at the bottom of the movement.
Squeeze to bring dumbbells back together and repeat.

name: Cable Crossover
description: A cable isolation exercise using high pulleys to adduct the chest through a full arc with constant tension.
instructions: Set cables to the highest position and stand in the center with one foot forward.
Grab both handles and lean forward slightly at the hips.
Sweep both arms down and forward in a wide arc until hands meet below chest.
Return to start under control and repeat.

name: Low Cable Fly
description: A cable fly using low pulleys to emphasize the upper chest through upward adduction.
instructions: Set both cables to the lowest position and stand in the center.
Grab handles with palms facing up and lean slightly forward.
Bring both arms up and together in an arc above the chest.
Slowly return to the start position and repeat.

name: Mid Cable Fly
description: A cable fly with pulleys set at chest height to isolate the mid chest with consistent tension.
instructions: Set both cables to chest height and stand in the center.
Grab handles with arms slightly bent and step slightly forward.
Bring both hands together directly in front of the chest.
Slowly open arms back to the start and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
description: A unilateral cable fly that isolates each side of the chest independently for balance and symmetry.
instructions: Set one cable to chest height and stand sideways to the machine.
Grab the handle with the far hand and step slightly away.
